name: Chão de pântano
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeatable top-down battlemap terrain painting texture. ONE square 1024 x 1024 edge-to-edge texture of dark damp peat, shallow olive brown water films, fine silt, small organic fragments, subtle wet moss and tiny roots. True orthographic overhead, realistic hand-painted material at a consistent physical scale: the tile represents 3 m by 3 m of ground. Absolutely seamless tile: all four opposite edges must match in tone, material, lighting and detail; no directional shadow, no vignetting, no border, no horizon, no large objects, no figures, no text, no grid, no focal subject, no transparent pixels. Subtle low-frequency variation, rich small material detail. Suitable for repeated large brush strokes without a visible patchwork pattern.
